event_description: User signs into Partner Studio via password or magic link. Property: method.
User requests a passwordless magic-link email from Partner Studio login (Supabase generateLink + Resend).
User signs out of Partner Studio.
User clicked Apply to become a partner from login or unauthorized page.

Partner successfully creates a new property listing (server-side). Properties: listing_id, bedrooms, price_usd, price_currency, has_min_lease, has_deposit, has_agency_fee, has_utilities, property_type.
Partner saves edits to an existing listing (server-side). Properties: listing_id, has_min_lease, has_deposit, has_agency_fee, has_utilities, property_type.
Partner changes listing availability status (server-side).
Partner submits a draft listing for admin review.
Admin approves a pending-review listing.
Admin rejects a pending-review listing.
Partner hard-deletes a listing and its photos.
Partner bumps a listing to refresh its sort position.
Partner confirms whether a listing is still available, reserved, or rented.
Partner sets the main listing photo.
Partner saves listing photo changes.
Partner saves commission settings on a listing.
Partner creates a new contact/lead record.
Partner updates a contact record.
Partner deletes a contact and unlinks their deals.
Partner links a contact to a listing, creating a deal pipeline entry.
Partner updates commission on a deal.
Partner disconnects a contact from a listing deal.
Partner saves a social-media post draft caption for a listing.
Partner opens or copies a public share link for a listing.
Partner opens a guide link from Studio guides.
Partner generates a team invite emailed via Resend with a one-click login link when possible. Property: emailed.
Partner copies a pending team invite link.
New team member accepts their invite and joins the studio.
Partner or admin revokes a pending team invite.
Partner starts the Facebook OAuth connect flow from Settings.
Partner successfully completes Facebook OAuth and connects their Page.
Partner disconnects their Facebook Page integration.
Partner opens the Publish on Facebook overlay from a listing Promote tab.
Partner publishes a listing to their connected Facebook Page. Properties: listing_id, photo_count, group_count.
Partner starts the guided group posting flow. Properties: listing_id, group_count, posted_to_page.
Partner marks a Facebook group as posted during the guided blast.
Server records a guided group post against listing history.
Partner clears Facebook post history for a listing.
Partner adds a Facebook group URL (Settings or Promote overlay).
Partner removes a Facebook group URL from Settings.
Partner saves company settings (name, logo, phone, WhatsApp/Zalo, email).
Partner uploads a company logo image in Settings before saving.
Partner removes the company logo in Settings before saving.
